description: What is physically loaded on the deck right now. This is the per-run file - edit it, do not edit deck.json or labware.json.

placements.name: tubes
placements.mount_note: NOT slot-mounted. The grid spans X 78-186, Y 151-223, so its centre (132.0, 187.0) sits BETWEEN slot 8 (200, 178.5) and slot 9 (65, 178.5) - 68 mm from one and 67 mm from the other. It straddles the slot boundary and cannot be assigned to either. Treated as a fixed station with an explicit anchor.
placements.anchor_note: machine coords of well (row 0, col 0). Column index advances toward -X at 12.0 mm; row index advances toward -Y at 18.0 mm.

placements.name: tips

corners.note: Three measured WELL CENTRES, not the box outline - the 100 x 63.7 mm span is far smaller than an SBS footprint. The grid is solved from these so real pitch and any rack rotation fall out of the measurement.

solved.note: col_pitch = 100.0/11, row_pitch = 63.7/7. Assuming the nominal 9.00 would accumulate ~1.0 mm of X error by column 12 - enough to miss a tip. Solved centre X 68.0 vs slot 3 centre X 65.0 is a 3.0 mm slot offset, which is what confirmed the x' = 420 + x frame.

placements.stale_note: The old TIP_X, TIP_Y = 218, 309 station in examples/300ulaccuracyprecision.py points nowhere near this box (X 18-118, Y 335.5-399.2). It is stale and is not carried forward.
